consumption.text: For very dense concrete with low permeability, the rate of application of Sika® FerroGard®-903 Plus can be reduced but must not be lower than 0.300 kg/m² (290 ml/m²)

consumption.label: Consumption
consumption.text: To assess project requirements, consumption and depth of penetration shall be checked on site using the Sika “Qualitative Analysis” – refer to the relevant method statement.

coats.label: APPLICATION
coats.text: Vertical surfaces: Normally, 2 to 3 coats are necessary to achieve the required consumption

coats.label: APPLICATION
coats.text: Horizontal Surfaces: Saturate surface by 1-2 coats, take care to avoid ponding

compat.text: Sika® FerroGard®-903 Plus is a surface applied mixed corrosion inhibitor, designed for use as an impregnation of steel reinforced concrete
compat.heading: DESCRIPTION

compat.text: Sika® FerroGard®-903 Plus is especially suitable for extending the service life of aesthetically valuable fair-faced concrete surfaces such as historic structures
compat.heading: USES

compat.text: Suitable for method 11.3 (applying inhibitor to the concrete) defined by EN 1504-9 for Principle 11 (anodic control)
compat.heading: CHARACTERISTICS / ADVANTAGES

compat.text: Can be used as part of a simple yet effective concrete repair and protection system
compat.heading: CHARACTERISTICS / ADVANTAGES

compat.text: Do not apply when rain or frost is expected
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Do not apply in tidal zones or to substrates saturated with water
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Do not apply to concrete in direct contact with drinking water
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: For fair-faced concrete or concrete to be further overcoated by coatings or hydrophobic impregnation, water blast the concrete surface with pressure (up to 18 MPa – 180 bars) For concrete surface to be further over-coated by cementitious material, roughen the surface using suitable abrasive blast cleaning techniques or high pressure water-blasting (up to 60 MPa – 600 bars)
compat.heading: SUBSTRATE QUALITY / PRE-TREATMENT

compat.text: When using a smoothing coat/pore filler over surface treated with Sika® FerroGard®-903 Plus, products such as SikaTop®-121, Sikagard®-720 EpoCem®, Sika Mono- Top®-107, SikaTop®-Seal 107, Sika MonoTop®-723 N, etc. can be used
compat.heading: APPLICATION

compat.text: Sika® FerroGard®-903 Plus is part of the Sika® Concrete Repair & Protection Systems:

precautionary_statements.text: P264 Wash skin thoroughly after handling.
P273 Avoid release to the environment.

precautionary_statements.statement: Wear protective gloves/ eye protection/ face protection.
precautionary_statements.text: P280 Wear protective gloves/ eye protection/ face protection.

precautionary_statements.statement: IF ON SKIN: Wash with plenty of water.
precautionary_statements.text: P302 + P352 IF ON SKIN: Wash with plenty of water.

precautionary_statements.statement: IF IN EYES: Rinse cautiously with water for several minutes. Remove contact lenses, if present and easy to do. Continue rinsing. Immediately call a POISON CENTER/ doctor.
precautionary_statements.text: P305 + P351 + P338 + P310 IF IN EYES: Rinse cautiously with water for several minutes. Remove contact lenses, if present and easy to do. Continue rinsing. Immediately call a POISON CENTER/ doctor.

precautionary_statements.statement: If skin irritation occurs: Get medical advice/ attention.
precautionary_statements.text: P332 + P313 If skin irritation occurs: Get medical advice/ attention.

precautionary_statements.statement: Take off contaminated clothing and wash it before reuse.
precautionary_statements.text: P362 + P364 Take off contaminated clothing and wash it before reuse.

precautionary_statements.statement: Dispose of contents/ container to an approved waste disposal plant.
precautionary_statements.text: P501 Dispose of contents/ container to an approved waste disposal plant.

storage.label: Conditions for safe storage
storage.text: Keep container tightly closed in a dry and well-ventilated place. Containers which are opened must be carefully resealed and kept upright to prevent leakage. Store in accordance with local regulations.

handling.label: Advice on protection against fire and explosion
handling.text: Normal measures for preventive fire protection.

handling.label: Advice on safe handling
handling.text: Avoid exceeding the given occupational exposure limits (see section 8). Do not get in eyes, on skin, or on clothing. For personal protection see section 8. Smoking, eating and drinking should be prohibited in the application area. Follow standard hygiene measures when handling chemical products

handling.label: Hygiene measures
handling.text: Handle in accordance with good industrial hygiene and safety practice. When using do not eat or drink. When using do not smoke. Wash hands before breaks and at the end of workday.

respiratory.label: Respiratory protection
respiratory.text: In case of inadequate ventilation wear respiratory protection. Respirator selection must be based on known or anticipated exposure levels, the hazards of the product and the safe working limits of the selected respirator.

hands.label: Hand protection
hands.text: Chemical-resistant, impervious gloves complying with an approved standard should be worn at all times when handling chemical products if a risk assessment indicates this is necessary. Follow AS/NZS 1337.1 Recommended: Butyl rubber/nitrile rubber gloves. Contaminated gloves should be removed.

skin_body.label: Skin and body protection
skin_body.text: Protective clothing (e.g. safety shoes, long-sleeved working clothing, long trousers) Follow AS 2210:3

engineering_controls.label: Appropriate engineering controls
engineering_controls.text: Use adequate ventilation and/or engineering controls to prevent exposure to vapours.
